sources.launcherCapture: Images/reference/16373615/incomplete/default-20261001T120904-49816/internal-bootconfig.txt: the Cuttlefish 1.57.0 launcher's bootconfig for build 16373615 (IR-305). Every key above not listed under 'decided' has the capture's value.

decided.androidboot.cuttlefish_service_bluetooth: No rootcanal on VZ; the boot reporter must not wait for Bluetooth, as on Cuttlefish's automotive product (android-image.md §7.6, IR-309).
decided.androidboot.force_normal_boot: Set by U-Boot on Cuttlefish; direct boot sets it here (android-image.md §6.2).
decided.androidboot.wifi_impl: virt_wifi on eth2 instead of the capture's mac80211_hwsim_virtio, which needs crosvm's virtio Wi-Fi and the OpenWRT VM (android-image.md §7.4).

omitted.androidboot.ddr_size: Instance layer: the VM memory size.
omitted.androidboot.lcd_density: Instance layer: the density of display 0.
omitted.androidboot.vhal_proxy_server_port: Host-side client with no host service (android-image.md §7.3).
omitted.androidboot.vsock_tombstone_port: Host-side client with no host service (android-image.md §7.3).
omitted.graphics keys: GPU-profile layer: gpuProfiles in this file.

additions.comment: The VZ direct-kernel path requires the documented hvc0 guest console (ADR-0015; android-image.md §6.4).

disks.comment: Read-only system disk (android-image.md §4.2). Partition sizes equal the image sizes; super is the unsparsed logical size.

The one writable instance disk (android-image.md §4.2, IR-308): no third disk, because the stock fstab hands vdc to vold as sdcard1. userdata is last so provisioning can grow it (§5.2); the template's 14 MiB is replaced by runtime.userdataGiB.
